action_sheet: Use case: illustration-story. Produce a high-resolution professional Japanese 2D cel animation DRAWING SHEET, not a comic. EXACTLY 5 columns by 3 rows, 15 equal rectangular cells, edge-to-edge uniform pale gray background, no borders, no text. Each cell has same fixed camera, same ground baseline at 88% cell height, whole character including feet within cell, same scale. Original anonymous adult slim-athletic male, broad anatomically shaped shoulders, black oversized thick soft hood permanently up, entirely pitch-black empty face opening NO face/eyes/skin. Matte black hoodie with ribbed cuffs and thick hem, charcoal cargo trousers, black sneakers, compact plain rectangular black technical backpack with visible depth and TWO shoulder straps, no emblem, no weapons, no glow. Beautiful forceful Japanese 2D animation draftsmanship, clean expressive tapered ink, anatomical volumes, distinct cel shadow planes, detailed plausible compression folds. Rear three-quarter view throughout. Read cells left-to-right top-to-bottom as 15 consecutive distinct drawings of ONE sidestep dodge to camera-right: 1 ready bent knees feet separated; 2 pelvis sinks over LEFT planted supporting foot; 3 deepest crouch hips left shoulders counterrotate right; 4 left ankle/knee extend driving hips right, right leg reaches; 5 left toe last ground contact torso accelerates right bag lags left; 6 airborne low lateral dodge right leg leading left trailing; 7 maximum evasive low torso twist shoulder axis counter to pelvis, bag trailing; 8 right shoe touches ground at right side; 9 right knee compresses and hips descend over planted right shoe; 10 deepest landing compression left foot swings in; 11 torso catches up bag swings right; 12 left shoe sets down right shoe stays planted; 13 knees recover bag overshoots; 14 stable wide crouch bag settles; 15 final settled alert low stance. Head hood angle changes with torso, shoulder versus pelvis twist, joint flexion and changing foreshortening, hoodie and bag delayed followthrough. This must be 15 independently REDRAWN whole bodies, not rigid parts rotated. Position progression within each cell must be physically coherent: starting center x40%, ending x60%, grounded shoes baseline identical; never cropped. No scenery, no effects, no speed lines. Grid precision essential for extracting equal cells. Highest available resolution.

Preserve thick hood cloth, structured volumetric shoulders chest pelvis, ribbed hem, compression folds and cel shading.
